english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an excerpt from a video or an audio recording.

examples.english: I've watched this clip many times.
examples.traditional: 呢個片段我睇過好多次。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 pin3 dyun6 ngo5 tai2 gwo3 hou2 do1 ci3

english.note: Use this for a fragment or excerpt of writing, speech, memory, or another non-physical whole rather than a broken physical piece.

examples.english: I only remember a fragment of what he said.
examples.traditional: 我淨係記得佢講過嘅說話片段。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gei3 dak1 keoi5 gong2 gwo3 ge3 syut3 waa6 pin3 dyun6
